scope: Posthoc formatting of the same completed supplements. Words outside bracketed citation IDs are unchanged and in original order. The original semantic review still applies. These rules are restricted to trailing citations.

SUPPORT.supplement: At the Iraqi Government's request, the Special Representative and UNAMI were to prioritize advice, support and assistance on inclusive political dialogue and reconciliation, with full, equal and meaningful participation of women, and consideration of civil society and youth input. [SUPPORT]

REVIEW.supplement: The Secretary-General was requested to conduct and provide the Council with an independent strategic review of UNAMI no later than 31 March 2024. [REVIEW]

CONSULT.supplement: The review was to consult Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, independent experts, civil society and Kuwait. Iraq's Government had expressed support for the independent review in a letter dated 18 May 2023. [CONSULT]

SCOPE.supplement: The review was to assess current threats and the relevance of UNAMI's tasks. The review was to make recommendations on mandate, structure and staffing. The review was to assess ways to support Iraq in strengthening regional cooperation. [SCOPE]
